plugins.name: pith
plugins.description: Token optimization for Claude Code. Automatic tool output compression (40-60% reduction), token meter in statusline, auto-compact at 70% context, structured output formats, self-building project wiki, URL ingestion, Karpathy compile pass, and semantic lint.

skills.name: pith-arch
skills.description: One-shot architecture decision format. Use for technology choices, design decisions, system design questions. Format: Decision / Options table / Choice / Risks / Next. Does not persist.
skills.description_zh: 为技术选择、架构和系统设计提供一次性决策格式：决策、选项表、选择、风险及下一步。不持久保存。

skills.name: pith-commit
skills.description: One-shot commit message generator. Conventional Commits format, subject ≤50 chars. Use when writing a git commit message for staged changes. Does not persist.
skills.description_zh: 根据已暂存改动一次性生成 Conventional Commits 提交消息，主题限制在 50 字符以内。不持久保存。

skills.name: pith-debug
skills.description: One-shot structured debug format. Use when diagnosing errors, unexpected behavior, crashes, or failures. Format: Problem / Cause / Fix / Verify — 4 fields, no prose. Does not persist.
skills.description_zh: 为错误、异常行为、崩溃或失败提供一次性结构化排障格式，仅包含问题、原因、修复和验证四个字段。不持久保存。

skills.name: pith-graph
skills.description: Run the Pith wiki graph generator for the current project. Scans wiki/ for .md files, extracts [[wikilinks]], and opens an interactive force-directed graph in the browser as wiki-graph.html.
skills.description_zh: 扫描当前项目 wiki/ 下的 Markdown 并提取双括号 wikilink，生成 wiki-graph.html，在浏览器打开交互式力导向知识图谱。

skills.name: pith-install
skills.description: Install Pith into Claude Code. Copies hooks, patches settings.json, registers slash commands (/pith, /budget, /focus), and records the plugin root so hooks can resolve paths.
skills.description_zh: 将 Pith 安装至 Claude Code，复制 hook、修改 settings.json、注册 /pith、/budget、/focus 命令，并记录插件根路径供 hook 解析。

skills.name: pith-plan
skills.description: One-shot planning format. Use for feature planning, task breakdown, sprint planning, implementation plans. Format: Goal / Steps / Risks / Done-when. Does not persist.
skills.description_zh: 为功能、任务拆分、迭代或实现方案提供一次性计划格式：目标、步骤、风险及完成条件。不持久保存。

skills.name: pith-review
skills.description: One-shot structured code review. Use when reviewing a PR, diff, file, or function. Format: one line per issue. No summaries. Does not persist.
headings: For a file with no path given
skills.description_zh: 一次性结构化评审 PR、差异、文件或函数，每个问题一行，不附汇总。不持久保存。

skills.name: pith-setup
skills.description: Pith onboarding conversation. Runs on first session in a new project. Introduces Pith, offers wiki setup, guides through initialization. Injected by session-start.js when no prior setup detected.
skills.description_zh: 在新项目首次会话中介绍 Pith、提供 wiki 设置并指导初始化；原说明由 session-start.js 在未发现此前设置时注入入门对话。

skills.name: pith-tour
skills.description: Interactive guided tour of Pith. Walks the user through each feature experientially — one step at a time, hands-on, using their actual project. Resumable. Skippable. State tracked via tour.py.
skills.description_zh: 在用户真实项目中逐步体验 Pith 各项功能，提供可恢复、可跳过的交互导览，状态由 tour.py 跟踪。

skills.name: pith-uninstall
skills.description: Uninstall Pith from Claude Code. Removes hooks, slash commands, and cleans pith entries from settings.json. Preserves ~/.pith/state.json (token history) unless user explicitly asks to wipe all data.
skills.description_zh: 从 Claude Code 卸载 Pith，删除 hook 和命令并清理 settings.json 的相关条目。默认保留 ~/.pith/state.json 的 token 历史，仅用户明确要求清除全部数据时移除。

skills.name: pith-wiki
skills.description: Wiki mode — persistent knowledge base maintenance. Active during /pith wiki mode. Defines page formats, ingest workflow, query workflow, and lint checks.
headings: Entity page (person, company, tool, service, component)
skills.description_zh: 在 /pith wiki 模式中维护持久知识库，规定页面格式、摄取、查询流程及 lint 检查。

skills.name: pith
skills.description: Adaptive output compression. Three levels: precise (no filler), lean (default, drop articles/fragments), ultra (maximum — abbreviate, structure, arrows). Activate: /pith | /pith precise | /pith lean | /pith ultra | /pith off
skills.description_zh: 按 precise、lean 或 ultra 三档压缩输出，分别减少空话、精简文字或更多使用缩写与结构。通过 /pith 系列命令启用、选择级别或关闭。

commands.name: budget
commands.description: Set a hard token ceiling per response (e.g. /budget 100) or clear it (/budget off)

commands.name: focus
commands.description: Load only the sections of a file relevant to the current question, reducing context noise

commands.name: pith-graph
commands.description: Run the Pith wiki graph generator for the current project. Scans wiki/ for .md files, extracts [[wikilinks]], and opens an interactive force-directed graph in the browser as wiki-graph.html.

commands.name: pith
commands.description: Control Pith token compression modes and access structured output formats, wiki, and status
